notes.title: Concubine Early Access Trailer is Live — Watch the Full Trailer Now
notes.content:
[p][b]The Early Access trailer for [i]CONCUBINE[/i] is live.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Watch the 4K version now:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/hhQG2xOAxRs"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Enter a dark-fantasy hack & slash ARPG set in a myth-haunted medieval Istanbul. [i]Concubine[/i] places you at the center of political intrigue and supernatural horror, a world of silk and shadow where you, the Sultan’s private assassin, will craft a hyper-detailed concubine, rescue and customize up to three companions, and purge a secret cult from beneath the city’s stones.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Featured Systems:[/b]
• Deep Character Customization — dozens of face & body sliders and HD skin rendering for realistic detail.
• Skill-Based Combat — Timing, positioning, and weapon mastery across one-hand, two-hand, dual wield, polearms, bows and special attacks.
• Companion & Harem Systems — Recruit companions who live in your Grand Palace Harem; furnish rooms, unlock rituals, and watch interactive routines.
• Procedural Instances & Exploration — Galata, Basilica Cistern, Yedikule, Rumeli Fortress, and Crypts with randomized layouts and bosses.
• Dynamic Loot & Economy — items vary visually and statistically; vendors refresh inventories and rewards scale with risk.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Development Note:[/b] The game will enter Early Access; this trailer previews core systems and the direction of the project. We welcome constructive feedback and community suggestions as we prepare for Early Access refinement and content expansion.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Content Warning:[/b] Contains mature themes and optional nudity. Settings will be configurable to match platform and player comfort.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for watching, leave us your thoughts in the YouTube comments![/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to join among wishlisters to be notified of Early Access.[/p]

notes.title: Echoes from the Cisterns: A New Build Emerges
notes.content: [h3][b]Time Moves Swiftly[/b][/h3][p]How quickly time slips away. It feels as if yesterday’s missive had only just departed our hands, yet more than two weeks have already passed. Each day within the palace carries its own intrigue, while beyond its gates, Istanbul continues to open doors to new adventures.[/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/3668fff14c7e51bcfb9ddf6e923b25f5dac8432a.jpg"][/img][b]New Foundations for the Character[/b][/h3][p]This week, our small circle of testers received a fresh build. For the first time, the health, mana, and stamina of our character are revealed on the screen suddenly, those carefully chosen attribute points weigh with greater meaning. A new “humble” starting outfit awaits as well; we thought to let you step into the palace a little more rough-hewn this time, though in truth, even rags seem to shine once inside these walls.[/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/928c3ede30900fd38a4d0502150d0ff967aab59b.jpg"][/img][b]Shadows of the City[/b][/h3][p]Three new places rise from the shadows: the Basilica Cistern, Yedikule Fortress, and Rumeli Fortress, each appearing as static instances in your path. Their mechanics are far from complete enemies fall too easily, loot remains ungenerous, and bosses still stand as little more than placeholders. Yet the ambience now begins to take shape, and with it the first taste of enemy variety and placement. Over the coming month, we will tune the challenge: balancing enemy strength, assigning loot and chest rewards, and weaving in level-completion treasures. The bosses themselves, however, will wait beyond Early Access; they deserve a more careful hand.[/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/b9aa1bc2dc42ad1c917a91eafda06e9da6ea6a93.jpg"][/img][b]Loot Learns to Change[/b][/h3][p]Loot, at last, has embraced the hand of chance. A blade dropped within one level may not be its twin elsewhere its hue, damage, armor, or stats may shift. Vendors, too, have learned to bargain with this new uncertainty, pricing weapons and armor according to their qualities, refreshing their wares as your journey progresses. Chest and quest rewards still belong to the older system, but soon all shall be aligned.[/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/0900a7d0dee589b0b39b849f60fab1b6fa6a5163.jpg"][/img][b]Scenes Before Battle[/b][/h3][p]New furnishings have found their place within the palace, though perhaps more exciting are the cutscenes now greeting you as you step into each level. Even before the clash of steel and the cries of battle, who could resist a moment to gaze down upon the field, to see the stage of war from above?[/p][p][/p][p]The palace grows, the city breathes, and the seventh moon wanes. Until the next whisper…[/p][p]-Team Upgrade[/p]

notes.title: Whispers from the Palace – After the Closing of the Test Build
notes.content:
[p]The palace gates have closed for now, yet within its chambers the work continues without rest. Our artisans, loyal testers, and the patrons who keep the lanterns burning still walk the unfinished halls, testing, adjusting, and shaping the dream of [i]Concubine[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]In recent days the palace has grown lighter to wander. The great burden of optimization has been lifted, and now even under the weight of epic settings, the courtyards shine at 100+ frames. A few shadows of performance still linger, but their cures are known and await their turn. Already, the battles and corridors feel smoother, more alive, as if the stone itself breathes easier.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/d3f94ce51b581672ddae5ffa4f3dd7ae2d264e0a.png"][/img][b]Of Faces and Beauty[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The mirrors of the harem have been polished. Presets and their icons have been refreshed, certain hairstyles cast aside like faded veils, while others have been touched with new luster. Plans for the art of make-up are already on the scribe’s table, promising subtler shades and more alluring detail.[/p][p][/p][p]On [url="https://www.patreon.com/c/concubine"]Patreon[/url], our scrolls grow thicker by the week. We share not only what we planned, but far more than we expected tales of hidden levels, inspirations behind the story, glimpses of the journey ahead. Each new patron is a candle in our night, and their number gladdens us.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/0ffffcc1a06686c1681b94af7b6b1bdbffdab645.png"][/img][b]A Beginning to the Tale[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]To ease newcomers into our story, a small [b]introductory film[/b] now opens the gates. No longer must travelers wander in blind silence. They shall learn where they stand, and why fate has led them here, before the path into danger begins.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ [/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/44f92f5313c87d02cfc6b42446ecc7ca3c094699.jpg"][/img][b]Companions on the Road[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Perhaps the most precious of recent additions: the ability to [b]choose your companions[/b] before stepping into peril. Those you rescue from their trials may join you, but only three may walk at your side into the levels beyond. Together you will fight and grow stronger. When the dust settles and you return to the palace, they will rest in their chambers while you navigate the intrigues that coil within the court.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ [/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/ba220740f20d47fa0478479254b26c151bd2f484.png"][/img][b]The Clash of Steel[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Our greatest labor remains the art of combat. Enemies now come in greater variety, their dances of steel less predictable, their strikes less synchronized. The arenas themselves grow more alive: horses no longer stand frozen like statues but shift with quiet breath. They will not bolt from battle, our story is not so vast, but they lend a spirit of life to the fields they inhabit.[/p][p]
⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ [/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/d405f232355f21433ef2b7484cd7b981294f5254.jpg"][/img][b]The Comforts of Home[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Even the quiet pleasures of the palace are not forgotten. The vendor’s stall now offers cushions, carpets, and furniture fit for an Ottoman chamber. The economy is not yet balanced, for the system of loot and reward is still being reforged, but the foundation stands. Soon the halls will invite not only conquest, but comfort.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ [/p][p][/p][p]The test build may be closed, but the story continues to grow, embroidered with every stitch of feedback and every moment of work. The next time the gates open, the palace will be richer still a place of shadow and silk, ready to welcome those who dare to step inside.[/p][p][/p][p]—[b]Upgrade Team[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Whispers from the Palace – The Fifth Moon of Testing
notes.content: [h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/d4614f0e7a2aa470362b118df1ffb3b5d2adc92b.png"][/img][/h3][p]Beyond the gilded gates of the Sultan’s palace, word drifts through marble halls and silk-draped chambers. It speaks of a tale still being woven, a story of intrigue, steel, and shadow: [i]Concubine[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Now, as the [b]third moon of testing[/b] wanes, our scribes record [b]1,670 brave testers[/b] who have walked the palace corridors, and [b]9,180 souls[/b] who wait at the gates, their hearts set upon the day they may enter.[/p][p][/p][p]Messengers have returned from faraway lands, their words carried on parchment, ink, and song. In the grand hall of Discord and the bustling bazaar of Steam, voices rise, some singing of the adventures they’ve had, others offering counsel for the journey ahead. From the storytellers of distant YouTube taverns to the scribes of foreign courts, our tale has begun to travel and we welcome all who would carry it further.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/7342000dd615a3b09f053805ad9f1e8edc0350f9.jpg"][/img][b]The Road to the Autumn Festival[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]With the autumn moon comes the great Steam Fest, where we shall open the gates in [b]Early Access[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Our intent: to let the people wander the palace gardens and shadowed alleys from October, and to unveil the full tale by the [b]first quarter of 2026[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]For now, our craft is to complete all the halls and courtyards, perhaps not flawless, but whole. Some rare jewels of design may remain locked away until after Early Access, yet if the palace stands strong and its stories flow, we shall be content. From there, the polishing will continue until every mosaic tile gleams.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/284477ce9fd6f88ac398ad6fd53d5bb528042c13.jpg"][/img][b]Matters Raised in the Court[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Every whisper from the crowd has been heard.[/p][p]The most pressing trouble when [b]three companions[/b] were by your side, their belongings tangled together in the chests has been swiftly addressed, though other matters delayed the update in the test build.[/p][p][/p][p]The harsh cry of the [b]rescue cage[/b] has been silenced as well. In truth, when the final tale is told, there will be no cages; rescues shall be living moments, hand-to-hand, heart-to-heart, woven into the story’s flow.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ [/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/c01983aa804cf68a824e33c67b8da9db2c86556b.jpg"][/img][b]Works of Craft and Design[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]While the masons finish the palace halls, the artisans tend to its living soul:[/p][list][*][p][b]The Lure of Treasure[/b] – We reshape the art of loot, so that each coin purse opened and each chest unlocked tempts you further. The rarer your spoils, the finer your arms and armor. This, we hope, shall be ready for the Autumn Festival.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Minds of Companions[/b] – For now, our goal is to keep them beside you in battle, avoiding their tendency to wander or linger too long in the palace halls. But should a wealthy patron bless our coffers, we dream of giving them true wit, the kind that makes them feel alive, as if stepped out of a tale like [i]Free Guy[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]The Furniture of Life[/b] – Perhaps a small thing to some, but to us, the ability to touch and use the objects you place in your chamber is the heart of roleplay. The carpenter’s stall has been transformed, now an Ottoman craftsman sells fine divans, low tables, and cushions to suit the palace’s style. Once placed, who would not wish to lounge upon them and capture the moment in a painted likeness?[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ [/p][h3][b]A Final Word[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The testing days have been rich with lessons and blessings. To those who walk with us, sending their words, their patience, and their belief, we bow our heads in gratitude.[/p][p][/p][p]October approaches, and with it, the gates shall open wider. Until then, may the winds carry our story to every corner of the realm.[/p][p][/p][p]—[b]Upgrade Team[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Of Blades, Silk and Shadows
notes.content:
[h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/7973edea050a3cd4034b3ef0324df647329ac4fc.png"][/img][/h3][p]We were planning to open the new test build earlier this July. 700 testers have already signed up, and we can’t wait to start. But as our palace became more dazzling, and the number of visitors grew, so did our nerves. Every bug began to shine brighter than the lights we worked so hard to perfect.[/p][p][/p][p]In our previous post, we unveiled a reborn, larger palace with a brand new lighting system. What we didn’t mention: the Caravanserai, Hippodrome, Crypt, and Galata levels all previously available have also been updated with new lighting, animations, and rebalanced combat. They’re not just ready they’re [i]beautiful[/i]. Also, deadlier. And no, the rest of the game hasn’t fallen behind. Most levels are in great shape, but this round of testing will focus on select areas to ensure quality over quantity.[/p][p][/p][p]So why the delay?[/p][p][/p][p]Short answer: 140 concubines.[/p][p][/p][p]Long answer: We wanted our palace to feel alive… and may have overdone it just a bit. Between the concubines, dynamic lights, AI behavior, and the ornate architecture, we ended up with a palace that could bring most systems to their knees dropping frame rates into single digits. The final straw came just when we were about to hit upload. We fixed the issue quickly (a few ladies had to be… excused), and now we're back on track.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/bedf1c7ce8024cc4a4601d5acce8972afc0ade8c.jpg"][/img][b]Combat Reforged[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This build includes a full overhaul of our combat animations and weapon handling. While the skill tree isn’t implemented just yet, we didn’t want to lock away the new special attacks so you’ll be able to test them freely. These attacks will eventually require investment, but for now, consider this a taste of power.[/p][p]Weapons included:[/p][list][*][p]One-handed and two-handed Ottoman swords[/p][/*][*][p]Bows (ranged combat now feels fluid and responsive)[/p][/*][*][p]Dual wielding for the brave (try it if you're lucky with drops)[/p][/*][*][p]Staves (which will eventually support magic, but currently function like polearms)[/p][/*][/list][p]The system is designed to reward timing, positioning, and awareness. Combat may feel challenging at first but if you pay attention to the new guidance system, manage your healing potions, and equip wisely, you’ll find your rhythm.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/05727f1682a3bde0c1a3b3612626ce9e2dea90c4.jpg"][/img][b]A Room of One’s Own[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Your main character’s room is a blank canvas, just like any other room you can buy in the full game. In the final version, players will decorate it themselves from the bed and wardrobe to mirrors and more. For this build, we’ve set up an example room modest but enough to give you a taste of what a decorated room feels like.[/p][p][/p][p]Want to try furnishing it yourself? Talk to the carpenter and pick up a few pieces you’ll see how placement, rotation, and interaction works. It’s a small but satisfying window into how your palace will become truly yours. Soon you will have different styles of furniture to create your dream rooms.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ [/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/f976551b93be861e5d90c6325322b82b9eaf3ec2.png"][/img][b]A Final Word Before Release[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]One important note: in this test build, death is harsh. If you die, you lose everything and restart. We’ll address this in the first update after the test goes live but to avoid further delays, we’re launching with the system as-is. Consider it a hardcore challenge (and don’t forget to heal!).[/p][p][/p][p]As we write this, the team is finalizing the last fixes. Some of us are in Canada where, conveniently, it’s still Monday. If we manage to hit send before they go to bed, technically we’ve kept our promise… right?[/p][p]Either way, we’re almost there. Thank you for your patience and welcome to the harem.[/p][p][/p][p]If you'd like to support the development, get exclusive behind-the-scenes updates, and play early builds like this one, consider joining us on [url="https://www.patreon.com/c/concubine"][u][b]Patreon[/b][/u][/url]. Your support is what keeps the palace gates open.[/p][p][/p][p]—[b]Upgrade Team
[/b][i]Where desire meets death.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: A Palace Reborn: Lights, Looks, and What Comes Next
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings Warriors of Silk and Steel,[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Our fourth Steam post took a little longer than expected because keeping our promises sometimes takes more time than making them. But we’re here, with brighter halls, better looks, and new faces in the team.[/p][p][/p][p]Since our last update, [b]two new artists[/b] joined our ranks. One of them is a [b]lighting artist[/b], and you’ll feel their magic the moment you step into the palace. Just compare the current character creation screen with the old one the difference is more than technical. Skin tones now glow more naturally, shadows wrap gently around curves, and the whole scene feels richer, warmer, more alive.[/p][p]
Together with our developers, the lighting artist also helped [b]refine camera angles and ambient moods[/b], making the world feel more immersive and intentional. We’re still tweaking things, of course this is a palace in progress.[/p][p][/p][p]Our second newcomer is a [b]3D organic artist[/b], and their work is already shaping what’s next. In future patches, expect [b]more natural, expressive hairstyles[/b] and a [b]wider variety of eye colors and facial details[/b] small touches that make your seductress truly your own.[/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of customization we’re now able to turn [b]your created characters into presets[/b] that can be shared across the player base! So here’s an idea:[/p][p]
 💎 What if we held a [b]Preset Showcase Contest[/b] among our test build players?
Winners get their concubines immortalized as selectable templates and bragging rights in the harem, of course.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/bb280e56d28957dd33a5b506120c9e32c87a3698.png"][/img][b]The Test Build Grows Bigger[/b][/h3][p][/p][p] The numbers are in:
 ✨ [b]450 players[/b] have signed up for the test build
 ✨ [b]120 content creators[/b] have requested early access[/p][p]That’s without a dedicated community builder on board just word of mouth, curiosity, and your support. Thank you for being with us as we scale things organically.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/579a9e0535e639aa3646ccbacd1b05015af23547.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]No New Levels (Yet)… But a New Palace Awaits[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We promised two new levels. They won’t be in this build but in their place, a [b]brand-new palace environment[/b] awaits.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to progress on onboarding, you’ll be able to [b]find your room and meet Destan[/b] without wandering for hours in candlelit confusion 😉[/p][p]
The lighting here is [i]chef’s kiss[/i]. We think you’ll want to take screenshots, lots of them.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯ [/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/6b60c8a618d908e229f3dd3c9e45b58b2b7ec9ba.png"][/img][b]Boss Fights, Reforged[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Bosses are getting serious upgrades.
 🩸 [b]Flavius[/b] no longer moves like a paper doll
 🩸 The [b]Ecinni fight[/b] now feels much tighter and more atmospheric
 🩸 [b]Alkarısı[/b] hasn’t been reworked yet but don’t expect her to die as easily next time[/p][p]Visual effects are being layered in as well, making these fights not just better balanced, but more dramatic. We’re building toward boss fights that [i]feel[/i] like events not just encounters.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/702911d119bc5e781422e041abfbc8e1c3dad4b5.png"][/img][b]Combat and Customization Notes[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]No difficulty selection yet, but we’ve tuned down the combat challenge a bit it shouldn’t feel as punishing as the previous build.
If you like speed and power, [b]dual wield[/b] might surprise you with how smooth it plays.[/p][p][/p][p]On the palace front: decoration options are still limited, but we’ve unlocked more rooms, so you can [b]test and play with existing décor systems[/b]. Even with a modest furniture set, the mood already feels distinct.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/p][p][/p][p]More is coming. Your feedback, your screenshots, your shared characters they shape how Concubine grows. We’re building this world with you, not just for you.[/p][p][/p][p][b]May your beauty shine brighter than your blades,[/b][/p]

notes.title: Velvet, Blades, and Rising Evil
notes.content: [h3][b]Greetings, Warriors of Seduction![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Another two weeks behind the curtains and this time, we dove headfirst into the realms of [b]physics and perspective.[/b] Sounds boring? Think again. Because finally… the clothes stopped floating like cursed cardboard in zero gravity. Yes, fabric now flows seductively, realistically as it should.[/p][p]Are there still quirks? Absolutely. But we’re smoothing those final creases. And thanks to our improved [b]camera system[/b], you can now admire even the finest detail... like [b]toe nails[/b]. (Which somehow caused us to [b]lose sight of finger nails[/b]. Dev magic,folks.)[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯  [/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/7c82e7464f519237f92eb3f6289da1037bd493b9.png"][/img][b]Combat: From Pillow Fight to Painful Precision[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Our first build had combat that felt… let’s say, “generous.” Now? It bites back. A little too hard, maybe.[/p][p]The dev team is [b]split in two[/b]: One side loves the brutality, the other just wants to feel powerful in pretty boots.[/p][p]Result? We’re planning to [b]add difficulty modes.[/b][/p][p]So whether you're a masochist or a monarch, you’ll find your pace in the harem.[/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯  [/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/e0fb05f80e137676994c6717512770fcaf2b4866.png"][/img][b]Light. Camera. (Still no action, but we’re close.)[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’ve been working on [b]onboarding[/b] — planning is done, implementation… not quite. Why? Because [b]lighting[/b] took center stage. And believe us, it was worth it.[/p][p][/p][p]We lit up the mysterious room where some of you couldn’t find Destan (you're not alone), and suddenly, it feels alive. One lamp. One dramatic shadow. One giant leap for immersion.[/p][p][/p][p]Next step? A [b]new team member[/b] has joined us to focus fully on the palace’s atmosphere. Our goal is to make you feel like you’ve walked into the pages of [i]One Thousand and One Nights[/i]. By the next build, we want you to [b]open your eyes in a whole new palace.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯  [/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/90437d63c6ab71b1c211b0cb57f5d6eb8e815b1a.jpg"][/img][b]Beasts, Bosses, and Beautiful Nightmares[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Our upcoming bosses; [b]Alamet[/b], [b]Serpent[/b], and the twisted twins [b]Yecüc & Mecüc[/b] are fully modeled in 3D.[/p][p]They’re waiting. Watching. (Still missing their moves, but that’s coming.)[/p][p]Our trash mobs are all planned, but haven’t been invited to the party yet.[/p][p]We hear them whining in dev limbo. Soon, sweet monsters. Soon. [/p][p][/p][p]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯  [/p][p][/p][h3]Small Steps. Big Promises.[/h3][p]Sometimes, progress feels invisible — until you put it all together. So here's our vow:  [/p][p]📍 Two new levels in the next build  [/p][p]📍 Boss encounters incoming  [/p][p]📍 Even better fashion physics (and hopefully, nails)  [/p][p]📍 The slow birth of our onboarding system[/p][p][/p][p]Follow us, wishlist the game, join our Discord, and tell us what detail you noticed that we didn’t. Because this isn’t just our dark fantasy  it’s yours too.[/p][p][/p][p]Until next time, May your blades stay sharp and your silks flow true.  [/p][p]— Team Upgrade[/p]

notes.title: The Seduction Begins
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/4e9c9eed7a8acaebfc9093b3ac72c987e085a7ab.png[/img]
It’s been a wild few weeks behind the scenes — And we finally did it.

We unleashed our new playable build to our handpicked group of testers. Around 150 testers from our Discord and friends & family entered The Ottoman Harem in disguise.  

Why so few testers? Simple: We wanted experienced developers & testers to share their ideas & judge our build before we go public testing and to make sure Concubine’s spark was real. It was🔥

The feedback of our community proved Concubine is what we want her to be - Deeper, bolder & more seductive than her predecessors. 

⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/2f2641743d417e14a04d6d20d477e312a8089ab3.png[/img][h3]Combat[/h3]

We dropped two big patches right after the test build — but don’t worry, you won’t find dry devlog talk here.

What you will find is:
[list]
[*] Enemies now strike back harder
[*] Camera now follows action & drama from a better PoV
[*] The game world has expanded
[/list]
Be warned, if you’re not prepared,  new AI will make you bleed & want to bleed more.

⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/a67a5a7dfc96a9b501da7ccb44390a544723a846.jpg[/img][h3]Character Customization[/h3]

You asked for more character presets, more variety, more beauty. 

So, incoming in next patches: 
[list]
[*] More body shapes, facial features, skin tones, and hair
[*] Sexy, stylized sliders to fine-tune your Concubine 
[*] One-click preset saves — And a one-click button to share them on Discord
[/list]
Now that our NDA is lifted, we encourage our testers to share their Concubines & companions anywhere they like - The seductive enchantresses like to be seen. 

⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/8920c4d6e67d524a545577b5c825412a0eb59ef9.png[/img][h3]World[/h3]

[list]
[*] Topkapi Palace is being remade - We have expanded The Palace to almost its real life size & added more rooms to decorate for your concubines & companions
[*] Protectors Cellar is getting a new vendor - The Beastmaster, the one who trades beast companions & stores them for you is about to take his post. 
[*] Random Instances - Three new areas with more evil & loot. 
[*] We hear a much stronger undead Byzantion Warlord is hammering the gates of Caravansarai. 
[*] Haunting whispers are rising from Byzantion Crypts under the Hippodrome - An unspoken evil stirs the catacombs. 
[*] Armor, costume & weapons sets are being added - We all want more! Make sure to let us know what kind of armor, costumes & weapons you want, and we’ll try our best to add them to our collection. 
[/list]
⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯

[h3]Jobs @ Concubine[/h3]

We’re looking for a Community Builder / Manager
We’re looking for experienced Modders 
We’re looking for design & development ideas - Gamers know best. 

⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯

Come join us at our Discord & wishlists and let’s build the most seductive & dangerous dark fantasy ARPG together. 

May you survive The Harem…

notes.title: Behind the Veil: Enter the Palace of War and Desire
notes.content:
Greetings, Warriors of Pleasure and Pain!

After more than a decade in game expos, indie support, publishing, and business development, we finally said, “Why not make the game we truly want to play?” That spark led us here — to Concubine. A risky move, maybe. But passion projects always are.

Some of you may have noticed our earlier experience with publishing and Steam-side wizardry. That gave us the confidence to take a bigger leap: building a game from scratch. A little stumbling, a lot of learning, and finally — we’re ready to show you what’s been brewing behind the velvet curtains.

Let’s lift the veil…

⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/8f72b9ee471af44477f4d8bfcbabeea14f19a9c9.png[/img][h3]Who will you be, behind the silks?[/h3]

In Concubine, you’ll step into the role of a dangerously beautiful palace concubine. But this is no tale of quiet submission — your character hides a secret mission: to protect the Sultan from an enemy hiding within his closest circle.

Will you unravel the plot, defeat your rivals, and live a life of decadent peace inside the palace walls?
Or will you walk away from it all, choosing freedom over gilded servitude?

⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/f737f31d5df591112ce20b26ace1937e3f57a67f.png[/img][h3]Shape your seductress[/h3]

Choose your concubine from multiple races and completely customize her look — from body shape to hair, eye color to attitude. She must be not just strong, but irresistible. Why? 
Because some enemies won’t just fall by sword… they’ll fall for her. Use seduction as a weapon. Use beauty as a blade.

⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/f94b902117459d46ade8827a90963ebc4e22fdd9.png[/img][h3]Fight like a queen. Or a devil in disguise.[/h3]

Our concubines don’t just pose — they fight. Fiercely. Viciously.
Wield blades, whips, bows, and exotic weapons. Travel across Istanbul-inspired battlegrounds. Uncover secrets in the Grand Bazaar. Duel rivals on the rooftops of Topkapı. Take down traitors in shadowy hamams.

On your journey, you’ll rescue other captive women and — if they prove worthy — ask the Sultan to place them under your protection… or turn them into trusted battle companions.

⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44647298/679f1ad969009e326a0e39c273a6a31b21baff80.png[/img]
[h3]Loot, seduce, decorate, repeat.[/h3]

Yes, there will be loot. Loads of it. Weapons, clothes, charms, jewels, and more. Power isn’t just in the fight — it’s in how you dress for it.

Back at the palace, decorate your secret chamber with exotic flair. Think One Thousand and One Nights meets power fantasy. If your taste pleases the Sultana, she might reward you with emeralds to redecorate more rooms…

And that’s just the beginning.

⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯

[h3]So, what’s next?[/h3]

We’re planning to release a [b]test build by July/August[/b] for early feedback from YOU — our growing community. Our target is [b]Early Access in October 2025[/b], with full release in [b]Q1 2026[/b] if all goes smoothly.

This is only the first of many updates. From now on, we’ll share more dev diaries, sneak peeks, and spicy secrets from the world of Concubine.

Follow us on Discord, wishlist the game, and tell us what you think.
This is your palace too.
